messages:
support_erin: Hey team — we have a customer escalation from Acme. Their usage chart in the Console dropped to zero for a 6h window and then shows one large spike (backfill) at ~02:00 UTC. Customer is seeing missing hourly rows and complains the billing looks wrong. Can someone look? :eyes:

matt_data: Looking now. I pulled the metrics; the hourly rollup table has a gap for 2026-03-15 18:00-23:00 UTC for multiple tenants, not just Acme.

anita_infra: Noted. I see a consumer group on the cdc-kafka topic that was throttled and had repeated rebalance events around that period. Also a few OOM restarts on etl-worker-03.

james_analytics: Any errors in the ETL logs?

matt_data: Yes — here's the most frequent stack:```
ETLWorker ERROR io.redwood.etl.RollupWriter - Failed to persist tenant_hours partition=2026-03-15-18 error=timeout
java.util.concurrent.TimeoutException: Write timed out after 30s
  at ...
Retrying (4/5)
```

matt_data: Looks like retries eventually succeeded which explains the backfill spike. But we had ~5 hours where consumer lag prevented hourly job from completing.

raj_support: Customer-facing msg: "We're investigating a delay in Console metrics; values will backfill and charts will update shortly. We're prioritizing fixes to avoid recurrence." Want me to send that?

sophie_product: Yes please send that update and include ETA if we can. Also capture affected tenants list.

anita_infra: Mitigation steps in progress: increased consumer parallelism for cdc-kafka, scaled etl-worker deployment to 5 replicas, and forced a catch-up replay from retention start for affected partitions. Triggered replay job: ```/infra/scripts/replay_cdc.sh --topic cdc-kafka --from-offset 14523000 --to-latest```

ingest-bot: started replay job replay-20260315-01 for partitions [3,4,7], status=running, submitted_by=anita_infra

matt_data: Ran a targeted backfill for tenant acme with the quick-backfill job. Monitoring output: looks like rows are being inserted and console chart is updating in near-real-time.

james_analytics: Follow-up action — add per-tenant alert for consumer lag > 10k for > 30min and a runbook link. Also we should add a fail-open policy so dashboard shows last-known values instead of zeros while backfill is pending.

support_erin: Sent customer update with ETA ~2h. Will follow up when backfill completes.

ingest-bot: replay job replay-20260315-01 status=completed, processed_messages=1,242,811, duration=00:51:23

matt_data: Backfill finished for affected partitions, console shows the missing hours populated for Acme and a few other tenants. I verified counts against source events.

sophie_product: Can we add a short postmortem to incidents with root cause and ops/playbook? I'll own tracking the postmortem.

raj_support: Customer notified that metrics are restored and billing exports should reconcile automatically. Closing escalation unless we see further drift. :thumbsup:

support_erin: Thanks everyone — closing on our side. Will add notes to the ticket and link the postmortem once Sophie posts it.
